sources.snippet: AGENT_GUIDE.md — LeRobot Helper for AI Agents & Users This file is a practical, copy-paste-friendly companion for any AI agent (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, etc.) helping a user work with LeRobot. It complements AGENTS.md (dev/contributor context) with user-facing guidance: how to start, what to train, how long, how to record, and how to calibrate an SO-101.

sources.snippet: The tutorial heavily builds on top of Lerobot-Sim2Real but tailored for SO101. We will show an example on how to train a RGB based model controlling an SO101 robot arm in simulation and deploying that zero-shot in the real world to grasp cubes.
